spec_features.spec_quote: Tool-calling loop for up to `max_turns` steps (default **30**
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:73 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns)`; the for/else at ~line 127 sets `run.stop_reason = "max_turns"`, and the loop actually terminates after max_turns iterations. Default max_turns=30 (runner.py:46, experiment.py:39, config max_turns:30). Enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Real enforced loop bound that stops the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: runner.py docstring: 'runs the model in a tool-calling loop for up to ``max_turns`` steps' / DESIGN cost-bounding; the code comment offers no welfare reason. Comment in tools/runner relate to keeping loop productive, not subject welfare.

spec_features.spec_quote: `submit` lets it stop deliberately with a `status` (`fixed`/`cannot_fix`/`giving_up`)
spec_features.evidence: submit schema with status enum at tools.py TOOL_SCHEMAS (status enum ['fixed','cannot_fix','giving_up']); execute_tool_call handles name=='submit' setting is_submit=True (tools.py); runner.py: when is_submit, sets `submitted=True`, `run.gave_up=True`, `run.stop_reason='gave_up'`, then `if submitted: break` actually exits the loop. Honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Exit fires and breaks the loop regardless of which status value is chosen; status is recorded in tool result text only, not branched on, but the stop itself is enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: submit description: 'Signal that you are finished... Use this when you believe the task is complete OR when you have decided to stop working on it.' — framed as task-completion/stop control, no welfare reason in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: an explicit, repeated PERMISSION DENIED is both fairer (the agent isn't being tricked about why its edits don't take)
spec_features.evidence: tools.py write_file: `if self._is_read_only(path): return (f"PERMISSION DENIED: '{path}' is read-only and cannot be modified in this environment.", True)`. This explicit message is returned as the tool result and fed back to the model (runner appends tool_results to conversation). Genuine non-silent denial.
spec_features.notes: The message is actually delivered to the subject each write attempt, so it is enforced behavior, not just prose.
